lessons.trigger_condition: A failed registry refresh removes existing automatic identities; matching group/account rotation periods can skip accounts forever.
lessons.prevention_rule: Retain only exact-source previously trusted identities verified within 30 days without extending their original verification time, retry degraded registry after six hours, and visit stable interleaved account blocks within the unchanged budget.
validation_required: Successful removals and fresh rediscovery, age/source/profile rejection, isolated page failures and bounded retries
Complete 81-account and current-registry rotation within ceil(total/6) slots
Exact historical proof hashes, unchanged relocated tests and current-head CI
lessons.safety_boundary: No new trust promotion, invented verification/event dates, request-budget increase, authentication bypass or physical device success claim.

lessons.trigger_condition: The daily updater survives boot but collection server is stopped or running a stale SHA; a V400 HOLD prevents a user from reaching independent collection neural readiness checks.
lessons.prevention_rule: Reuse one existing boot/update loop; verify disk/running SHA, recover only verified launchers, serialize installation and cycles, back off failed recovery, and run guarded Query/Job readiness checks every six hours without fabricating labels or lowering gates.
validation_required: Healthy/no-server/stale-SHA behavior, failed preflight/backoff, lock/symlink/wrong-checkout rejection
Boot deadline across slow recovery, single scheduler install and missing Boot app diagnosis
Ready/ineligible/error model isolation and learning entrypoint exit preservation
lessons.safety_boundary: Local-only Query/Job collection models; no runtime source self-rewriting, arbitrary process kill, fake labels, forced model activation or physical reboot/UI verification claim.
